description: DEPRECATED, not implemented. Grants write access to id.sifa.graph.connection, which is itself deprecated: Sifa derives connections from mutual id.sifa.graph.follow records and writes no connection record. Sifa does not request this set, and sifa-api does not register it, so a PDS granting it would confer nothing. Retained so the NSID is not reused. Original intent: OAuth permission set for creating and managing professional connections.

main.title: Professional connections
main.detail: DEPRECATED, not implemented. Create and manage professional connections with other users.
